text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday was injured,
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Yeah, like this, I might just be able to run marvelously.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer.
Can I go back to training?
choice_data_list: Let's play it safe and rest for now.
Let's see how it goes with some light training.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Why? I'm totally fine, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even if the symptoms are mild right now, we can't completely rule out the risk of the injury worsening during training.
I explained this to Marvelous Sunday."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Even the slightest lapse in focus
could be fatal, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday took it easy to focus
entirely on her recovery.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if the symptoms are mild, returning to regular training while injured carries risk.
I told them to keep it within safe limits without pushing themselves.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Understood. I'll do as you say, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Nn... It kinda hurts a bit...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ...I think I'll pass on training after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because she pushed herself too hard,
Marvelous Sunday's injury seems to have worsened...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—...Yup! Simply Marvelous☆★
I can still keep running!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday continued light training
and made a smooth return.
